Understand the privacy details
01

Review before it goes.

Inspect mail sends, calendar changes and browser actions before dispatch. See receipts. Uncertain results aren’t automatically replayed.

02

A memory you can open.

Inspect the source quote behind learned facts. Edit, forget or switch off automatic learning. Your context is yours to manage.

03

Room for a private moment.

Private sessions, an optional macOS app lock, history retention and an external-API pause put useful controls within reach.

04

A way back, built in.

Encrypted portable backups, previewed merges and capture recovery help keep your work safe. Restore without replaying actions.

Before you begin

The workspace macOS 14+ · Swift 6 tools or Xcode to build

Local AI with Splash Supported Apple silicon · macOS 26.4+ · 24 GB+ memory for the compact preset

Meeting transcription macOS 26+ and a supported installed speech language

Initial setup and optional service connections need internet.

A few things you might be wondering

A little more clarity.

Can I use Puddle without connecting any accounts?+

Yes. Your local tasks, priorities, notes, memory and work context work without email or calendar accounts. AI conversations need a connected local Splash server. You can add external connections later.

Does everything stay on my Mac?+

Your workspace is stored locally with encryption, and AI inference runs through your local Splash server. Optional email, calendar, GitHub and Atlassian connections communicate with their services. Browser control uses Cua Driver, which has separate permissions and privacy settings. Puddle is local first; it is not a promise that connected services work offline.

Can Puddle send emails or change my calendar?+

Yes, with optional provider permissions and your review of the exact proposed content. Actions shows dispatch status and provider receipts. Reading an email does not mark it read. Scheduled routines are read-only.

What can the Developer workspace do?+

Read and search selected project folders, cite source lines, inspect Git status and working or staged text diffs, and save development sessions. It can also use connected GitHub, Jira and Confluence context. Editing code, running builds or tests, and semantic indexing are not implemented.

Can it join and transcribe meetings?+

Puddle opens supported Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex join links and provides notes, preparation and on-device transcription on macOS 26+. Google Meet browser attendance is experimental and starts only when you explicitly request it. Admission rules and website changes can require manual attention. Transcription needs the relevant audio permissions and an installed supported language.

What should I know before trying it?+

Puddle is currently built from source. Public distribution and some live-account, hardware and accessibility acceptance checks are still in progress. Inbox, calendar and document results have explicit limits; Knowledge supports extracted text, PDF and DOCX, with no OCR or spreadsheet workbook parsing. Check the roadmap and feature guide for current details.
